name: Yahagi Construction Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yahagi Construction Co.,Ltd. engages in the construction, civil engineering, and real estate business in Japan. It operates through Construction, Civil Engineering, and Real Estate Business segments. The company constructs warehouses, port and waterway facilities, logistics centers, condominiums, commercial facilities, hotels, office buildings, airport terminal buildings, residential site development, roadways, railways, railway stations, aseismic reinforcement, and slope face reinforcement.
